prerequisite: E character presentation must be engine-green before F runtime implementation starts.
purpose: Prepare low-cost living Shire NPC/fauna/environmental motion on top of existing ownership instead of creating a parallel AI brain.

ownership_model.LivingWorldDirector: Owns region population budgets, activation windows, pooled actor admission/retirement and coarse world-state events.
ownership_model.ShireNPCContextSubsystem: Owns per-NPC context projection, bounded memory/knowledge lookup, relationship/context queries and conversation context assembly.
ownership_model.ShireQuestSubsystem: Owns quest/progression facts and exposes read-only gates to NPC context/dialogue.
ownership_model.rule: Systems communicate through bounded event/context contracts. NPCs do not poll one another or directly own global population/world budgets.

runtime_cost_model.per_npc_tick: Avoid for context/social reasoning; use scheduled/budgeted updates and event-driven refresh.
runtime_cost_model.perception: UE4.27 native AI Perception/navigation where required; bounded by activation radius and budget.
runtime_cost_model.heavy_assets: Soft references plus asynchronous FStreamableManager loading.
runtime_cost_model.dialogue_fallback: Deterministic authored/template dialogue must function with no AI service.

knowledge_and_rumor_contract: An NPC may only learn a fact from authored initial knowledge, a witnessed tagged event, or a permitted transfer from another NPC.
Transferred rumors preserve source/event identity and knowledge gates.
No NPC receives future knowledge solely because the player or another system knows it.
Optional AI/local model may phrase an already-authorized utterance but cannot create canon facts or outcomes.
Raw conversation transcripts are not the long-term memory store; structured memory records are.

fauna_contract.updates: Distance/visibility/activity-budget driven rather than full-rate global Tick.
fauna_contract.story_rule: Fauna cannot block locked canon beats or required traversal.

bottleneck_guards: LivingWorldDirector never performs per-frame full-NPC context reconstruction.
ShireNPCContextSubsystem exposes cached/bounded context snapshots instead of forcing global scans.
Conversation eligibility queries are local to nearby/active NPCs.
World-state fan-out is event-driven and coalesced where multiple systems consume the same change.
No cloud request is allowed to stall game-thread dialogue availability.
prototype_first: One named Shire NPC above the existing systems before expanding to broader named NPC coverage.
acceptance: Pool reuse and activation/deactivation behavior is observed without state leakage.
Player traversal and quest state are not blocked by inactive/pooled NPCs.
evidence_boundary: Preparation only. No runtime, AI-behavior, PIE/device or performance acceptance claim.
